name: South Asian University
address: Gaushala Road, Maidan Garhi, New Delhi 110068

facts.label: A regional university
facts.text: Established by the eight SAARC member nations to advance learning and collaboration across South Asia.
The agreement establishing SAU was signed in New Delhi on 4 April.
SAU welcomed its first students in August.
The university moved to its residential campus in Maidan Garhi in January.

mission.text: SAU brings learning and research together to deepen regional understanding, nurture leadership and strengthen South Asia's shared capacity.
